title: The Kindly House
author: Z. M. Joubert
blurb: Lior Winterbourne, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
